name: GO Classes CS 2025 | Weekly Quiz 34 | SQL | DBMS

question.text:
Consider the relation: Scores(Team, Opponent, RunsFor, RunsAgainst) and the query:

 

SELECT DISTINCT Team, RunsFor FROM Scores

Which is true:

  1. 1 appears once
  2. 5 appears twice
  3. 6 appears 4 times
  4. All are true.

Relation R has schema $\mathrm{R}(\mathrm{a}, \mathrm{b}, \mathrm{c})$.
SELECT a, b, c
FROM R
ORDER BY c DESC, b ASC;
In the result of the above query, what condition must a tuple $t$ satisfy so that t necessarily precedes the tuple $(5,5,5)$ ?
Identify such tuples from the list below.
  1. $(3,6,3)$
  2. $(1,5,5)$
  3. $(5,5,6)$
  4. $(3,3,5)$

Given the following table Scores(Team, Opponent, RunsFor, RunsAgainst) and query.


SELECT * FROM Scores WHERE RunsFor > 5
Which tuple is in the result?

  1. (Swallows, Carp, 6, 4)
  2. (Swallows, Carp, 4)
  3. (12)
  4. Empty Table

Consider the following SQL query:
SELECT DISTINCT s1.sname, s1.age
FROM student s1, student s2
WHERE s1.age > s2.age
This query returns
A: The name and age of one of the oldest student(s)
B: The name and age of all of the oldest student(s)
C : The name and age of all of the youngest student(s)
D: The name and age of all students that are older than the youngest student(s)
